additional_info.subject: RE: ID0434644-DC/Si-D/DE-[Multiple]Chargers not onboarded in Sifinity Control CRM:02681000422
additional_info.body:
Hi Dan,
Greetings of the day,
We have checked the Sifinity Control. We could find chargers.
We may need to check for the space and backslash.
Pls validate following:
Pls note that Data of SID in Sifinity Control is fetched from SCB.
So, If charger is on SCB, it must be on Sifinity control.
Also, With SID, It is mandatory to onboard it on SCB to make it work.
Do let us know if you have any other query. Else, We will proceed with closure of the case.
Thank and Best Regards,
